Experience working in fast-paced environments, balancing high quality with speed. Full professional proficiency in English Preferred:   Experience building and shipping production-quality interfaces with AI coding tools (Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, v0, etc.), reducing or removing the need for front-end handoff. Experience in fintech or payments in Brazil. Background in early-stage startups, especially in 0→1 environments. Familiarity with user research, testing, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase). The Target CompaniesCandidates with at least 2 years of full-time experience in the companies below will be prioritized:   Strong Fintechs: Nubank, Revolut, Wise, Mercado Pago, Brex, Itaú, Cora... Strong Local Digital Product Companies: Quinto Andar, i Food, Wildlife, Mercado Livre, Globo... Strong Design Consultancies: Work& Co, Metalab, Huge, R/GA, Accenture Song... Big Tech: Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft Other Tech: Notion, Netflix, Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Spotify, Snap, X (Twitter), Pinterest The Selection ProcessMaterials about Nova, including a pitch deck and pitch videos will be made available through the processPortfolio Review: Async review of your portfolio by the design team to assess craft, depth of thinking, and end-to-end product work. Portfolio is required.Screening Call: 15 min call with HR for alignment on requirements and qualifications.Deep Dive Interview: 60 min call with Hiring Manager to deep dive on past experiences and profile.Bar Raiser Interview: 45 min call with another leader to validate assessment with a 2nd opinion.Cultural Fit Interview: 30 min call with CEO to evaluate culture fit and answer questions about Nova.The Offer Package   Model: PJ Compensation: aggressive salary Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Solutions Architect
description:

This is Adyen   Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.  For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.  Solutions Architect   Adyen is looking for a Solutions Architect with a solid understanding of and hands‑on experience with technology, integration design, project management and a strong merchant focus. As an implementation consultant, you will be the primary point of contact for our merchant's technical teams, guiding them through the design, development, testing, and launch phases of their integrations with Adyen's platform. Your focus will be on ensuring an exceptional merchant experience throughout the project lifecycle.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on diverse projects that encompass various payment solutions, including e‑commerce platforms, marketplaces, and card issuing programs. By leveraging your technical proficiency and business acumen, you will play a vital role in guaranteeing a smooth implementation process and maintaining open lines of communication with our merchants and internal teams. This position is based in our Brazil office, and the ideal candidate is both consultative and technical.  What you’ll do:    Utilize development and programming expertise to create scalable and robust solutions for merchant integrations, while ensuring adherence to payment best practices.  Serve as a consultative partner in specific verticals such as e‑commerce, point of sale, and multi‑faceted platforms, guiding merchants through integration processes.  Collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Account Managers, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver seamless merchant experiences and drive continuous improvements.  Leverage project management and technical consulting skills to oversee high‑quality project delivery, guaranteeing the technical integrity of merchant integrations.  Provide consultation on optimizing payment solutions, including checkout experiences, authentication, omni‑channel payments, and platform onboarding, while collaborating with Developers and Product Managers to enhance the platform.    Who you are:    C1 level proficiency in Portuguese and English is required for this position.  5+ years of technical consultative experience, providing guidance and recommendations for clients integrating Web API solutions. Experience in payments is a plus.  Proven ability to quickly learn new technologies, understand complex systems (APIs, databases, SDK's, etc.), and desire to improve technical acumen.  Excellent communication skills; comfortable leading discussion with different audiences, e.g. development team, non‑technical stakeholders and leadership.  Ability to understand how different systems work together within a larger software environment. This includes in-depth knowledge and debugging of REST or similar API protocols.    Check out what our implementation teams have to say about their roles here and here.  Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments   Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them – voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.  Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!  What’s next?   Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.  This role is based out of our São Paolo  office. We are an office‑first company and value in‑person collaboration; we do not  offer remote‑only roles.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

JOB DESCRIPTION  Creative Directors are responsible for defining and nurturing the product’s vision, understanding the company’s strategic goals, and keeping everyone’s efforts focused towards the same direction.  Always aligned with the Production Manager and the Head of Studio, Creative Directors are responsible for defining and constantly reviewing the scope to keep projects on budget and on time. The Creative Directors will articulate their vision, fostering an environment of collective creativity that inspires the team to come up with the best ideas, choosing the ones that fit into a coherent whole.  MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:   Define a clear and reasonable creative vision for the product.  Work closely with the Core Team members to develop their specific parts of the vision, tying together all artistic and technical elements.  Constantly review the priorities and scope of each product delivery and/or milestone together with the Product Manager, considering the Value Proposition and goals of the product, but at the same time championing the product’s unique vision.  Review production timelines, budget, and team performance with the Product Manager.  Nurture and communicate the overall creative direction on an ongoing basis, inspiring the team through leadership.  Be aware of internal and external QA results to direct creative decisions, ensuring the product meets main stakeholders' needs.  Guarantee the consistency and quality of the product, ensuring creative cohesion between the user experience and company strategy.  Serve as the spokesperson for the product’s vision within the team, for the press, and corporate management.    MUST HAVE:   Experience in a creative leadership position on at least one high-quality professional entertainment product/property shipped or delivered in industries such as XR, Games, Movies, Television, Advertisement, or Comics. Understanding and sensitivity to capturing the spirit of the moment (Zeitgeist). Huge curiosity and openness to research and expand knowledge in virtual reality games, narratives, immersive art, etc.    NICE TO HAVE:   Familiarity with Google G Suite, Monday, Slack, and Github. A passion for Games, Movies, TV, Art, Animation, Electronics, RPGs, Literature, Theater, Popular Culture, and narrative experiences.  Knowledge of other project management techniques. title: Senior Data Scientist
description:

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA   A diretoria de Data & Analytics na Blip é responsável por empoderar a empresa na geração de conhecimento, guiando-a em tomadas de decisão data-driven e impulsionando a inovação através dos dados. Tem, portanto, um papel fundamental na evolução da Blip.  Nossa área de Data for Services tem como missão gerar valor para nossos clientes por meio da implementação de serviços de dados de alto valor agregado, com foco em diagnósticos aplicados, modelagem estatística, análises preditivas e prescritivas. Atuamos intencionalmente para impulsionar a satisfação dos clientes, fortalecer o uso de dados desde o design na plataforma e promover experiências hiperpersonalizadas.  Como Cientista de Dados Sênior, esperamos que você seja referência técnica em ciência de dados e práticas de Machine Learning Operations (MLOps), atuando na concepção e implementação de soluções analíticas escaláveis, conduzindo experimentos avançados, compartilhando conhecimento e acompanhando tendências do setor para garantir excelência técnica e impacto de negócio.  Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e tem dúvidas se pode se candidatar, saiba que todas as vagas da Blip são também para pessoas com deficiência. Estamos esperando sua inscrição!  RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES   Conduzir e liderar estudos analíticos avançados, utilizando métodos estatísticos e Data Science para identificar padrões ocultos, prever comportamentos e maximizar o valor e os resultados estratégicos do negócio.  Traduzir problemas de negócio complexos em hipóteses analíticas rigorosas e soluções data-driven de alto impacto.  Projetar, desenvolver e operacionalizar modelos preditivos e prescritivos de ponta (ex: regressão, classificação, séries temporais).  Garantir a robustez e a sustentabilidade dos modelos em produção, aplicando as melhores práticas de MLOps, versionamento de modelos, monitoramento e re-treinamento automatizado.  Colaborar ativamente com as equipes de Engenharia de Dados e Product Managers (DPMs) para otimizar pipelines de dados de feature engineering e viabilizar a aplicação de modelos em escala e com baixa latência.  Contribuir diretamente para a evolução da arquitectura analítica e da governança de dados e modelos, sugerindo melhorias em processos, infraestrutura e padrões técnicos.  Liderar experimentos e provas de conceito de inovação em IA aplicada a negócios, como NLP, previsão de demanda, detecção de anomalias e sistemas de recomendação.  Atuar como mentor técnico, disseminando o conhecimento e as melhores práticas de Ciência de Dados por meio de oficinas, code reviews e liderança de projetos complexos.  Estimular e ser um agente de transformação na promoção de uma cultura analítica, garantindo que as decisões em toda a empresa sejam fundamentadas em evidências e dados de alta qualidade.    REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES   Domínio em Python para análise e modelagem estatística;  Proficiência em SQL e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;  Experiência sólida com bibliotecas de ciência de dados (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, PySpark);  Vivência com Spark e/ou processamento distribuído;  Conhecimento em estatística inferencial, testes de hipótese e análise multivariada;  Experiência comprovada com modelagem preditiva e avaliação de desempenho de modelos (MSE, ROC, AUC, etc.);  Domínio de data storytelling, traduzindo insights técnicos complexos em narrativas claras e acionáveis para audiências executivas e não-técnicas.;  Vivência em MLOps, incluindo o uso de GIT para versionamento de código, pipelines de CI/CD e monitoramento de modelos em ambiente produtivo.  Capacidade de traduzir hipóteses de negócio em soluções analíticas;  Habilidades de colaboração, curiosidade, comunicação e liderança técnica.    Será um diferencial se você tiver:   Vivência com plataformas de dados modernas como Databricks ou experiência em ambientes de cloud (Azure, GCP, AWS) para Data Science.  Experiência prática com MLOps, CI/CD, deployment de modelos e automação de pipelines analíticos e monitoramento contínuo de modelos em produção.  Proficiência em domínios de IA aplicada, como NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural), Deep Learning, ou forecasting.  Conhecimento sólido em metodologias de experimentação causal, A/B testing e/ou análise bayesiana para inferência robusta.  Vivência em Power BI ou outras ferramentas de data visualization. Principais atividades:   Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;  Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;  Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);  Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);  Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;  Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;  Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.    Experiências que buscamos:   Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;  Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;  Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;  Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;  Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;  Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.
